title: Brands asked to keep supplying David Jones despite unpaid debts
paragraphs: David Jones's embattled suppliers have been asked to continue providing goods and services to the collapsed retailer, despite having no guarantee they will be reimbursed for previously unpaid debts.
Documents seen by ABC News show the unclear situation facing suppliers after the 188-year-old retailer was plunged into receivership and voluntary administration this week.
"It is really stressful," Jacob Leung told ABC News.
